accordion.description: Stacked sections that expand one or many panels at a time.

alert.description: Inline status messaging for info, success, warning and error states.

alert-dialog.description: A modal that forces an explicit choice before a destructive action.

avatar.description: Image with initials fallback, presence badge and grouped stacks.

badge.description: Compact labels for status, counts and categories.

breadcrumb.description: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy.

button.description: Six variants and four sizes with icon and loading slots.

calendar.description: Month and range selection built on react-day-picker.

card.description: A bordered surface for grouped content and actions.

chart.description: Theme-aware chart wrapper with tooltips and responsive containers.

checkbox.description: Binary choice with an indeterminate state and keyboard support.

collapsible.description: Reveals a single region when the user asks for it.

color-picker.description: Hex picker with native color input, validation and preset swatches.

command.description: Searchable command palette wired to the ⌘K shortcut.

context-menu.description: Right-click actions with submenus and shortcuts.

dialog.description: Accessible modal dialog with focus management.

drawer.description: Bottom sheet navigation for touch-sized screens.

dropdown-menu.description: Anchored action menu with checkbox and radio items.

empty.description: Composable empty state with media, title, copy and actions.

form.description: React Hook Form field wrapper with labels, descriptions and errors.

hover-card.description: A rich preview that appears on hover or focus.

input.description: Single-line text field with invalid and disabled styling.

input-number.description: Numeric field with steppers, bounds, precision and keyboard control.

input-otp.description: One-time-code input with grouped slots and paste support.

label.description: Accessible label that connects controls and descriptions.

pagination.description: Page links with previous, next and ellipsis states.

popover.description: Anchored floating panel for filters, pickers and menus.

radio-group.description: Single choice from a short, visible list.

resizable.description: Split views with draggable, keyboard-accessible handles.

scroll-area.description: Custom scrollbars for dense lists and panels.

segmented.description: Compact single-select for views, ranges and modes.

select.description: Accessible dropdown with grouped, search-friendly options.

skeleton.description: Neutral placeholders that hold layout while data loads.

slider.description: Track and thumb input for continuous or stepped values.

sonner.description: Toast notifications with actions, descriptions and undo.

spinner.description: Inline loading indicator with an optional accessible label.

switch.description: Instant on/off control for settings that save automatically.

table.description: Semantic table primitives with sticky headers and compact rows.

tabs.description: Switch between related views without leaving the page.

textarea.description: Multi-line text input with a resizable height.

toggle.description: Pressable button that keeps an on/off state.

toggle-group.description: Single or multiple toggles sharing one segmented surface.

tooltip.description: Short contextual hint on hover or keyboard focus.

anchor-nav.description: Scroll-spy section links that highlight the region in view.

auto-complete.description: Free-text input with filtered suggestions and full keyboard control.

back-top.description: Floating button that returns long pages or panels to the top.

combobox.description: Searchable select with descriptions, disabled options and clear.

notification-center.description: Bell inbox with unread counts, read state and mark-all.
